title: Grade 9 · Session 22 · Build V15
note: Holes are counted from the left, the front or the bottom, as the finished model faces the camera: motor on the right, blue front frame at the front.

steps.instruction: Hold the motor with its shaft pointing left, as shown.
Push a peg into the motor face, in the hole behind the shaft.
Push a peg into the motor face, in the hole in front of the shaft.
Press the red beam onto both pegs, using holes 7 and 9 from the front.
Push the short black axle through red beam hole 8 into the motor shaft.
Slide a 16-tooth gear onto the black axle, against the red beam.

steps.bom: Perpendicular Axle Joiner 3L with Pegs (light grey)
steps.instruction: Press the joiner's pegs into red beam holes 2 and 4 from the front.
Start a second assembly: stand a grey frame upright.
Push the long grey axle through the frame's top row, hole 7 from the front.
Slide a 16-tooth gear onto the axle's short right end, against the frame.
Join both assemblies: gears mesh, axle into red beam hole 6, joiner pegs into the frame.
Push a peg into the frame's bottom row, hole 8 from the front.
Push a peg into the frame's bottom row, hole 4 from the front.
Press the second red beam onto both pegs, using holes 3 and 7.
Push a peg into the second red beam's hole 8 from the front.
Push a peg into the second red beam's hole 2 from the front.
Press the plate's right side onto both pegs, using side holes 3 and 9.
Slide the 40-tooth gear onto the long axle, all the way to the frame.
Slide the 8-tooth gear on, leaving a one-and-a-half-hole gap after the 40-tooth gear.
steps.check: Please check: is the gap between the 40-tooth and 8-tooth gears really one and a half holes?

steps.instruction: Push the long black axle from the left through frame top hole 4, the joiner and red beam hole 3.
Slide an 8-tooth gear onto the black axle, leaving a two-hole gap to the frame.
Slide the second 40-tooth gear onto the black axle, against the 8-tooth gear.
Slide a 24-tooth gear onto the black axle, against the 40-tooth gear.
Slide the other 24-tooth gear onto the grey axle, flush with its left end.
Push a peg into the plate's left side, hole 9 from the front.
Push a peg into the plate's left side, hole 6 from the front.
Push a peg into the plate's left side, hole 3 from the front.
Press the second grey frame onto the three left pegs; the black axle goes through top hole 4.
Turn the whole model upside down.
Push a peg into the plate's underside, second row from the front, hole 5.
Push a peg into the plate's underside, second row from the front, hole 1.
Press the blue block onto both pegs, using its front row, holes 1 and 5.
Turn the whole model back the right way up.
Push a peg into the motor's back, top hole nearest the red beam.
steps.check: Please check: the motor's back holes are described by position, not counted.

steps.instruction: Push a peg into the motor's back, lower hole at the far right end.
steps.check: Please check: the motor's back holes are described by position, not counted.

steps.instruction: Push a peg into the motor's back, top hole at the far right end.
steps.check: Please check: the motor's back holes are described by position, not counted.

steps.instruction: Press the white square frame onto the three motor pegs from behind.
Push a peg into the white frame's right side, second hole from the bottom.
Push a peg into the white frame's left side, second hole from the bottom.
Push a peg into the plate's back edge, hole 5 from the left.
Push a peg into the plate's back edge, hole 3 from the left.
Press the white 15 beam onto the four back pegs, using holes 2, 4, 9 and 15.
Start the servo assembly in front of the model: servo in its holder, shaft up.
Push a peg up into the servo holder's right hole from below.
Push a peg up into the servo holder's left hole from below.
Move the servo assembly over the blue block; lower its pegs into front row holes 10 and 12.
Start the front frame assembly: lay the blue H block in front of the model.
Push a peg into the H block's back, top row, hole 5 from the left.
Push a peg into the H block's back, top row, hole 3 from the left.
Press the blue 11 beam onto the top pegs, using holes 5 and 7.
Push a peg into the H block's back, bottom row, hole 5 from the left.
Push a peg into the H block's back, bottom row, hole 3 from the left.
Press the blue 5 beam onto the bottom pegs, using holes 3 and 5.
Push a peg into the blue 11 beam's back, hole 1 at the left end.
Push a peg into the blue 11 beam's back, hole 8 from the left.
Push a peg into the blue 5 beam's back, hole 1 at the left end.
Push a peg into the blue 5 beam's back, hole 4 from the left.
Push the front frame onto the model: top pegs into both grey frames, bottom pegs into the plate.
Start sub-assembly 7 on the mat, front left: lay a blue 5 beam front to back.
Lay a second blue 5 beam parallel, one hole to its left.
Push a peg into the right beam's front hole.
Push a peg into the left beam's front hole.
Push a peg into the left beam's back hole.
Push a peg into the right beam's back hole.
Press a blue 3 beam across the two front pegs, using its end holes.
Press the second blue 3 beam across the two back pegs, using its end holes.
Turn sub-assembly 7 upside down.
Push a peg into the back blue 3 beam's middle hole, between the long beams.
Turn sub-assembly 7 back over and leave it flat on the mat.
Start sub-assembly 8 on the mat, front right: lay a white C block front to back.
Lay the second C block beside it, flipped, one hole to its right.
Push a peg into the left C block's front end, left hole.
Push the long peg through the left C block's front end, right hole; it sticks out below.
Push a peg into the right C block's front end, left hole.
Push a peg into the right C block's front end, right hole.
Press a blue 5 beam across the front ends onto all four pegs: holes 1, 2, 4 and 5.
Press the lift arm onto the servo shaft, its far end pointing toward the black axle.
Push a white peg joiner down into the lift arm's far-end hole.
Slide a half bush onto the black axle's right end, about one hole from the red beam.
steps.check: Please check: "about one hole" is approximate; in the model the gap is a little under one hole.

steps.instruction: Slide a second half bush on, against the first.
Slide the hole pin onto the black axle, its pin pointing up.
Slide a half bush on, against the hole pin.
Slide the last half bush on, against the third.
Press the second white peg joiner down onto the hole pin's pin.
Lift the C block assembly onto the model: long peg into the H block, C blocks either side of the joiners.
Lower the beam assembly onto the C blocks; Peg 33 goes into the top peg joiner.
